manifest.summary: A non-flag option with a flag value can be invoked without a following argument, and the contract is documented and exercised.

items.title: Recognize the flag value as an argument-free invocation
items.before: The needs-value decision depended only on whether the default was unset.
items.after: A configured flag value also marks the option as usable without a following argument.
items.statement: Option initialization now includes flag_value in the decision that controls argument consumption.

items.title: Describe the optional-value contract
items.before: The changelog and Option API notes did not describe this invocation form.
items.after: The changelog and Option API notes state when a flag can be accepted without an argument.
items.statement: Release-facing and API-facing text records the same option behavior.

items.title: Exercise string and converted flag values
items.before: The option suite did not contain these two optional-value examples.
items.after: The suite invokes a string flag value and an integer-converted flag value without following arguments.
items.statement: The CLI runner observes both direct substitution and type conversion.
